definition: Hands-on creation and refinement of software code to implement new functionality and ensure operability.
inclusion_criteria: Tasks involving writing, structuring, or extending program modules to deliver features or fixes.
exclusion_criteria: Activities centered on managing projects, data workflows, or communicating findings rather than coding itself.
examples: Design and code program modules for new features; implement new logic in existing applications.

definition: Systematic identification and resolution of defects to maintain software reliability and performance.
inclusion_criteria: Investigations and fixes that trace, test, or refactor code to remove errors or inefficiencies.
exclusion_criteria: Initial feature design without troubleshooting; project-level oversight; data analytics or visualization work.
examples: Review, refactor, and troubleshoot code to resolve defects; replicate and fix reported bugs.

definition: Upfront structuring of scope, milestones, resources, and budgets to guide delivery efforts.
inclusion_criteria: Defining objectives, timelines, budgets, and risk assumptions with sponsors or leadership.
exclusion_criteria: Day-to-day task execution such as coding or data prep; post-launch monitoring without planning components.
examples: Define project scope, milestones, and budgets with sponsors; produce project charters or roadmaps.

definition: Orchestrating people, vendors, and workflows to keep interdependent tasks aligned during execution.
inclusion_criteria: Scheduling, assigning, and facilitating collaboration across technical teams and external partners.
exclusion_criteria: Strategic planning without active coordination; deep technical tasks like coding or data modeling.
examples: Coordinate technical teams and vendors to execute project plans; manage dependencies between workstreams.

definition: Ongoing oversight of progress, risks, and status to ensure projects remain on track.
inclusion_criteria: Tracking milestones, reporting status, escalating risks, and adjusting plans based on performance data.
exclusion_criteria: Initial planning or resourcing decisions; hands-on delivery tasks such as coding, data prep, or analysis.
examples: Monitor risks, report status, and adjust plans to keep projects on track; maintain status dashboards.

definition: Acquiring, cleaning, and organizing datasets to make them ready for analysis.
inclusion_criteria: Collecting data from sources, handling quality issues, and structuring datasets for downstream modeling.
exclusion_criteria: Statistical modeling, interpretation, or stakeholder messaging performed after the data is prepared.
examples: Acquire and clean datasets from multiple sources; resolve missing or inconsistent fields before analysis.

definition: Applying analytical methods to extract patterns, build models, or summarize trends from prepared data.
inclusion_criteria: Querying, modeling, or visualizing datasets to derive findings that inform decisions.
exclusion_criteria: Raw data collection/cleaning or final communication of insights to non-technical audiences.
examples: Build queries, models, or dashboards to summarize trends; run statistical analyses on processed data.

definition: Translating analytical findings into clear narratives, visualizations, and implications for stakeholders.
inclusion_criteria: Preparing presentations, dashboards, or explanations that connect data results to business or user decisions.
exclusion_criteria: Coding, data wrangling, or internal project governance activities without outward-facing interpretation.
examples: Visualize findings and explain implications to stakeholders; deliver briefings that link metrics to actions.
